name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box there, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires carrying it again after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Whenever the exit is reached, the box must be in hand.
Whenever the box falls, carry it again.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3, u4
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u4
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u4, holding_box) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box, u2) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box, u4) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box, u4) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u2, box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u4, holding_box, u3) -> 11
